description: Read Locus settings. Returns every setting key with its current value, type, allowed values or range, default, and description; sensitive, experimental, restart-required, and project-scoped settings are marked. Without `keys`, the output also lists configuration not yet in the settings table (credential status, model defaults, tool permissions, MCP servers, UI preferences) as read-only context. Use the returned keys with config_set to change settings.

prefix.description: Optional key prefix on dot boundaries, e.g. `unity`, `agent.subagent`, `appearance`, or `notifications`. Also accepts the older categories (general, api, models, permissions, knowledge, mcp) for the configuration listed after the settings table.

keys.description: Optional exact setting keys to read. Overrides `prefix`.
